summary: Narrow wooded residential street; flat lower end, homes 19-25 m away on both sides.
reasons: Narrow lane, little room beside it

best_section.where: Bottom of Ironside Street, near the bend before the lower junction

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 19-26 m away on both sides; tree cover helps a little.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed narrow lane; a few cars park at the kerb and trees crowd the east edge, so room is tight.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end style residential street; little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street but no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep above 55 m: about 14% from 0-55 m, best section about 1.5%
Tight verge on a narrow lane
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy, mostly east and south of the section; shaded much of the day.
cannot_judge: Whether the lane is wide enough to pass a parked van
